passages.heading: Cancellations
passages.text: A refund is available if your train is cancelled.

passages.heading: Onboard
passages.text: Breakfast is served in the dining car.

passages.heading: Your account
passages.text: You can reset your password in the app.

passages.heading: Advance tickets
passages.text: Advance tickets cannot normally be refunded. This restriction does not apply when the operator cancels your train.
